svg.title: Community and optional Cloud hosting management
svg.desc: The local app implements start and move requests to Cloud. Hosting control and ordinary Community participation have separate authority. Move archives go from the local server directly to the returned Community upload target. Imports and optional configured OIDC are implemented. Host takedown and evidence operations are explicit exceptions to ordinary content access. Contract support does not establish hosting deployment availability.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local DorkOS app + server
Start / move UI + Cloud relay implemented
Agents execute here
